sentences.en: WOMAN: Good evening.
King's Restaurant.
Example
MAN: Good evening.
I'm ringing about the job I understand you have vacant.
sentences.zh: 我打电话是想咨询一下，听说你们有一个职位空缺。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Oh yes.
MAN: I'd like to find out a few more details, if I may.
sentences.zh: MAN: 如果可以的话，我想再了解一些详细情况。

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes, of course.
Can I take your name?
sentences.zh: 我可以记下您的姓名吗？

sentences.en: MAN: It's Peter Chin.
WOMAN: Okay Peter.
Well, if you want to ask about the job and then if we're both still interested, we could arrange for you to come for an interview.
sentences.zh: 嗯，如果您想了解这份工作的情况，之后如果我们双方仍有兴趣，就可以安排您来面试。

sentences.en: MAN: Great, thanks.
I'm afraid I missed the advert for the job but heard about it from a friend.
sentences.zh: 很抱歉，我没看到招聘广告，是从一位朋友那里听说的。

sentences.en: WOMAN: That's no problem at all.
What would you like to know?
MAN: Well, um, what sort of work is it - washing up?
sentences.zh: MAN: 嗯……这份工作具体做些什么——是洗碗吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: It's answering the phone.
MAN: Oh right, fine.
WOMAN: And not waiting at table.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 而且不包括在餐桌旁服务。

sentences.en: MAN: That'd be good.
And how many nights a week would it be?
sentences.zh: 一周需要工作几个晚上呢？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Well, we're really only busy at the weekend.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 实际上我们只在周末比较忙。

sentences.en: MAN: So two nights?
WOMAN: Three actually, so it would work out at twelve hours a week. a
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 实际上是三个晚上，这样算下来每周共十二小时。

sentences.en: MAN: That'd be fine.
It wouldn't interfere with my studies.
WOMAN: Are you at the university?
MAN: Yes.
First year Physics student.
WOMAN: Oh, right.
MAN: Um, and because I'm not an EU national would I need a work permit?
sentences.zh: MAN: 嗯……由于我不是欧盟国家公民，我是否需要申请工作许可？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Yes you would.
Just get your tutor to sign it.
sentences.zh: 只需让您的导师签字即可。

sentences.en: MAN: That wouldn't be a problem, if I were to get the job.
sentences.zh: MAN: 如果我能获得这份工作，这应该不是问题。

sentences.en: Um, where exactly is the restaurant?
WOMAN: Well, we have two branches - the one we're recruiting for is in Hillsdunne Road.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我们有两家分店——这次招聘的是位于希尔兹邓恩路的那家。

sentences.en: MAN: I don't know that.
sentences.zh: MAN: 我不太熟悉这个地方。

sentences.en: How do you spell it please?
WOMAN: It's H--double L-S-D-U-double N-E Road.
MAN: Got that.
Thanks.
Is it near a bus it stop?
WOMAN: Yes.
The nearest one would probably be just beside the Library.
sentences.zh: 最近的车站很可能就在图书馆旁边。

sentences.en: MAN: Oh yes, know it.
sentences.zh: MAN: 哦，是的，我知道那个地方。

sentences.en: That'd be fine for me.
And could I ask about the pay?
sentences.zh: 另外，我能问一下薪资情况吗？

sentences.en: WOMAN: We're offering £4.45 an hour.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我们提供每小时4.45英镑的薪酬。

sentences.en: MAN: That's very good.
My last job was £3.95 an hour.
sentences.zh: 我上一份工作是每小时3.95英镑。

sentences.en: WOMAN: We feel it's pretty good and we also offer some good fringe benefits.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 我们觉得这相当不错，而且我们还提供一些很好的附加福利。

sentences.en: MAN: Really?
WOMAN: Well, we give you a free dinner, so you eat well.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 嗯，我们为你提供免费晚餐，所以你的伙食会很好。

sentences.en: MAN: Right, better than hostel food!
sentences.zh: MAN: 好的，总比宿舍的食物强！

sentences.en: www.TopSage.com Tapescripts
WOMAN: +8 We certainly hope so!
sentences.zh: WOMAN: +8 我们当然希望如此！

sentences.en: And we also offer extra pay for working on national holidays.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们还为在国家法定节假日上班的员工提供额外报酬。

sentences.en: MAN: Oh, that's a really good perk, isn't it?
sentences.zh: MAN: 哦，这真是个非常不错的福利，对吧？

sentences.en: WOMAN: TonSage.com Yes, we think so.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: TonSage.com 是的，我们也这么认为。

sentences.en: And then because of the difficulties of getting public transport, if you're working after 11 o'clock we drive you home.
sentences.zh: 另外，由于公共交通不便，如果你晚上11点以后还在工作，我们会开车送你回家。

sentences.en: MAN: Oh, that's good to know.
WOMAN: Well, we'd certainly be interested in inviting you for an interview, if you're still interested?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那么，如果你仍有兴趣的话，我们很乐意邀请你来参加面试。

sentences.en: MAN: Oh yes, certainly.
Could I just also ask what qualities you're looking for?
sentences.zh: 我还能顺便问一下，你们在招聘时最看重哪些素质？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Well, for this particular job we want a clear voice, which you obviously do have!
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 嗯，这份工作我们需要声音清晰的人，而你显然具备这一点！

sentences.en: MAN: Thanks.
WOMAN: And you must be able to think quickly, you know.
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 而且你还必须具备快速思考的能力，明白吗？

sentences.en: MAN: Well, I hope I'd
sentences.zh: MAN: 嗯，我希望我能做到。

sentences.en: WOMAN: So, when could you come in for an interview?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 那么，你什么时候能来参加面试呢？

sentences.en: We're actually quite quiet tonight?
sentences.zh: 我们今晚其实比较清闲。

sentences.en: MAN: Sorry, I couldn't come tonight.
sentences.zh: MAN: 抱歉，我今晚来不了。

sentences.en: Or tomorrow, I'm afraid.
Thursday's okay - that'd be 22nd of October.
WOMAN: Fine, after 5 p.m.?
sentences.zh: WOMAN: 好的，下午5点以后可以吗？

sentences.en: MAN: Yes, fine.
Would 6 o'clock be okay?
WOMAN: Perfect.
And could you bring along the names of two referees?
sentences.zh: 另外，请带上两位推荐人的姓名，好吗？

sentences.en: MAN: Yes, that's fine, no problem.
WOMAN: Good.
I look forward to seeing you.
MAN: Oh, by the way, who should I ask for?
sentences.zh: MAN: 哦，对了，我该找谁呢？

sentences.en: WOMAN: Oh yes, of course, sorry.
My name is Samira Manuja.
MAN: Can you spell that, please?
WOMAN: M-A-N-U-J-A.
MAN: Okay, I've got that.
Thanks very much.
WOMAN: Look forward to seeing you .
